noConnection.title: No connection
noConnection.description: We could not load your account. Check your connection and try again.

home.roleTrainer: You are logged in as a trainer.
home.roleAthlete: You are logged in as an athlete.

accept.title: You have been invited to FitnessApp
accept.description: Your trainer sent you this invitation. Accept it to get started.
accept.otherSession: This device is logged in as {{who}}. If you accept, the invitation's session will replace it.
accept.invalidDescription: This invitation link is not valid or is incomplete. Ask your trainer for a new one.
accept.passwordDescription: You will use it with your email to log in to the app.
accept.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least {{min}} characters long.
accept.linkingDescription: We are linking your account to your trainer.
accept.unlinkedDescription: The account {{who}} is not linked to a trainer. If your trainer sent you an invitation, accept it now.

send.title: Invite an athlete
send.description: Create an invitation link and send it yourself, for example on WhatsApp. The app sends no email.
send.linkHelp: It is valid for 24 hours. Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
send.copyFallback: It could not be copied automatically. The link is selected: copy it by hand.
send.offline: You need a connection to invite athletes. Try again when you have signal.

pending.title: Pending invitations
pending.loadError: The invitations could not be loaded.
pending.hint: To get a new link, invite the same email again; the old link stops working.

errors.wrongCredentials: The email or the password is not correct.
errors.network: No connection. Check your signal and try again.
errors.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask your trainer for a new one.
errors.weakPassword: That password is not valid. Try a longer one.

accept.notAuthenticated: Your session is no longer valid. Log in or ask your trainer for a new link.
accept.invitationNotFound: There is no pending invitation for your email. Ask your trainer for a new one.
accept.invitationExpired: The invitation has expired. Ask your trainer for a new one.
accept.alreadyHasTrainer: You already have an active trainer, so you cannot accept another invitation.

invite.unauthorized: Your session is no longer valid. Log out and log in again.
invite.invalidRequest: Check the email and the name, and try again.
invite.alreadyLinked: That person already has an active trainer, so they cannot be invited.
invite.inviteFailed: The invitation could not be created. Try again.
invite.serverMisconfigured: The invitation server is not configured correctly. Tell whoever runs the app.
invite.methodNotAllowed: The app sent a request the server does not accept. Update the app and try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

envError.title: Missing configuration
envError.description: The app cannot start because these environment variables are missing or invalid:
envError.hint: Copy .env.example to .env.local, fill in the values (npm run db:status) and restart the dev server.
